card.name: Asterisk starting a table footnote
card.fires_on: An asterisk (*) that sits right after a table entry or number and begins a footnote line, or a wildcard star in code. It appears at the end of table rows or reference lists.

modes.label: Table footnote marker
modes.description: An asterisk after the last numbers or text of a table row that introduces the footnote.
modes.example: mg BID* 82 6 (1) 6 (1) 80 5 (2) 4 (1)<< *>>Blood pressure measurements made after 3 weeks

modes.label: Star in code or emphasis
modes.description: An asterisk used as a shell wildcard or markdown emphasis in technical text.
modes.example: ls -l /dev/cd1bls: /dev/cd1b: No such file or directory ls -l cd1<<*>>brw-r----- 1 root operator

card.plain: It fires on a star symbol that marks a footnote under a table of numbers.
